messages:
Maddie: Heads-up: major splash at Civic Center BART platform. Someone lost a sneaker into a puddle. Commute chaos. :sweat_drops: :sneaker:
Ethan: Yikes. Im on the platform. Service hold for a while while they clear water from the down escalator. Bring dry socks if youre nearby.
Riya: I have two pairs in my bag. Leaving one with security. Label it 'for soggy feet'.
Kofi: ETA on trains? App shows a hold but unclear if it's system-wide.
TransitBot: BART alert: https://bart.gov/alerts/2026-03-23 | Civic Center: temporary hold due to surface flooding. Estimated resume 10-30 mins.
Maddie: Thanks @TransitBot. Also shoutout to the janitor who arrived with a mop and heroic stare.
Ethan: If anyone needs a short-term ride to Mission, Ive got room for two. Leaving in 5.
Samira: Ill take you up on that if Riya can't get the extra socks. My shoes are dripping.
Riya: Socks claimed for Samira  left at security. Also pro tip: put a plastic bag over shoes before the platform. Works marginally.
Kofi: Quick poll: should we add a small "commute kit" box to the lobby (socks, plastic bags, travel-size umbrella)? React :+1: for yes, :shrug: for meh.
Maddie: :+1: definitely.
Ethan: :+1: and add a tiny towel.
Maddie: Alright folks, trains moving slowly now. If you took Ethans ride, ping when you land. If not, hold tight and dry off. See you soon. :raised_hands:
